data_fields.name: respawn_variance
data_fields.donor_constant: variance seconds per spawn point, uniform base +/- variance/2

data_fields.name: entry_spawn_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: npc_spawn_limit per spawn entry (0 = no cap)

data_fields.name: group_spawn_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: group_spawn_limit per spawn group (0 = no cap)

best_idea: When the last player leaves a zone, keep its NPCs stepping for a grace period, then freeze them until someone returns, while spawn points keep their own respawn timers and capped weighted draws as data.
decision_why: The grace-then-freeze gate and the per-point respawn timer with variance and caps fit a zone-as-data population. Reject despawn-on-empty as the default: the donor freezes NPCs and removes only depop-flagged ones, so despawn would need its own rule. Re-check the row 23 wording with Lead before building.
acceptance: A server test: the last player leaves; NPCs step for grace_s (zone data, default 60) and then stop; a player re-entering inside the grace window cancels the freeze; a spawn point flagged path-when-idle keeps stepping; a capped entry is not drawn while its count is at the cap.
